title: MonitorOutput
description: Output from the Monitor Agent: scored and ranked story candidates from RSS feeds.

story_id.description: Unique identifier for this story (slug or hash).

title.description: Headline or title of the story.

relevance_score.description: How relevant this story is to the target audience (0-1).

novelty_score.description: How novel/unique this story is compared to recent coverage (0-1).

recommended_format.description: Recommended video format for this story.

sources.description: List of source URLs for this story.
